descriptions.w3d_h1_set_and_register_8034883c: Stores the value at offset 84, passes it with the list at offset 72 to 0x80210b90 and returns zero.
descriptions.w3d_h1_fill_allocated_blocks_80353454: Fills each slot of [begin, end) with a new 128-byte block from the handle storage allocator, using the fallback allocator when the first fails.
descriptions.w3d_h1_set_and_register_80349b20: Same as 0x8034883c: stores the value at offset 84, passes it with the list at offset 72 to 0x80210b90 and returns zero.
descriptions.w3d_h1_string_tree_erase_8035a3f8: Recursively erases a red-black tree of string-valued nodes: erases the right subtree, destroys the node's string and releases the node, then continues with the left child.
descriptions.w3d_h1_fill_allocated_blocks_8035ec0c: Same as 0x80353454: fills each slot of [begin, end) with a new 128-byte block, using the fallback allocator when needed.
